name: MolGlueDB_search_compounds
description: Full-text search MolGlueDB for molecular glue degrader (MGD) compounds -- small molecules that induce targeted protein degradation without a PROTAC's warhead-linker architecture. Matches target protein, recruiting protein (e.g. E3 ligase), compound name, or other indexed fields. Example: keyword='IKZF2' returns glues degrading IKZF2, each with SMILES, pharmacophore/scaffold class, degradation potency, and recruiting protein. Distinct from ToolUniverse's PROTAC-DB tools, which cover the separate bifunctional-degrader modality.

keyword.description: Search term: target protein ('IKZF2'), recruiting protein ('CRBN'), or compound name ('Lenalidomide').

name: MolGlueDB_get_compound
description: Retrieve a single MolGlueDB molecular glue degrader compound by its numeric compound_id (from MolGlueDB_search_compounds results). Returns full structural (SMILES/InChIKey/formula), pharmacophore/scaffold classification, degradation potency, and source-publication data.

Core.description: The scaffold family the glue belongs to, e.g. 'LenalidomideType'. Which chemical series a molecular glue comes from.

IUPAC.description: Systematic IUPAC name. Note the measured example names a trideuteriomethoxy group - an isotopologue the formula alone does not reveal.

ModeOfAction.description: Whether the glue acts 'non-covalent' or covalently. A covalent glue's occupancy and washout behave differently, which changes how the degradation figures should be read.

MolWeight.description: Molecular weight as a STRING, e.g. '446.48'. Needs converting before arithmetic.

Pharmacophore.description: The degron-binding motif, e.g. 'Glutarimide'. The part that engages the E3 ligase, and so what the glue's selectivity follows from.

PrimaryTargetDegInfo.description: Measured degradation of the primary target, as text, e.g. '70% degradation at 100 nM'. The potency, carrying its own concentration - it is not a DC50 and must not be read as one.

RecruitingProtein_UniProtID.description: UniProt accession of the E3 ligase component recruited, e.g. 'Q96SW2' (CRBN). The half of the ternary complex that is not the target.

ResearchStage.description: How far the compound has got, e.g. 'Discovery', 'Preclinical', 'Clinical'.

SecondaryTarget.description: Another protein the glue degrades, e.g. 'CK1α'. The off-target that decides whether the glue is selective.

SecondaryTargetDegInfo.description: Measured degradation of that secondary target, e.g. '62% degradation at 100 nM'. Compared with the primary figure it is the selectivity margin - 70% against 62% is barely selective.

SourceAddress_Website.description: Link to that source, e.g. 'https://doi.org/10.1021/acs.jmedchem.3c01736'. The citation for every number in the record.

SourceName.description: Where the data was published, e.g. 'J. Med. Chem.'.

StdInChIKey.description: Standard InChIKey, e.g. 'JGWFFKIYBDZDFI-FIBGUPNXSA-N'. The structure key for joining to other chemical databases.
